summary: Strengthen sampling, result review and water-safety response skills. Explore this practical five-day water quality training course.
lede: Water quality training helps officers, analysts and operations professionals plan sampling and act on monitoring results. Participants practise creating sampling plans, checking field and laboratory records, interpreting results and trends, and prioritising risks. They also develop corrective actions and decision-ready reports for routine monitoring and incident follow-up, with sensor monitoring covered at an operational overview level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who collect, review or act on water-quality evidence in routine monitoring and operational response.
modules: Water Quality Objectives and WHO Guidance
prerequisites: Working familiarity with water sampling, routine water-quality parameters or laboratory results is expected. Coding is not required.
topics: Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
